messages:
Ellen Park: Heads-up
 MercuryPay wants a 10-day POC to validate a compat adapter that maps their incumbent vendor API to Redwood. Top asks: token-count parity for billing, stop-token semantics, and answers to their sec questionnaire. Can eng + security scope?

Tom Alvarez: I can run the POC. Need their canonical prompts (30) + 10 known failure cases. Confirm latency SLO (they requested p95 < 250ms). Also confirm whether exact token match is mandatory or a small tolerance is OK.

Priya Patel: Tokenization is the trick. Options: (1) run Mercury's tokenizer in the shim (accurate, adds CPU), (2) normalize text pre-tokenize (cheap, approximate). For exact billing parity we should run their tokenizer in the adapter. I can ship a harness + example mapping.

Ben Goldman: Ops notes: will need their staging allowlist CIDR, and whether they want logs exported to their S3 for reconciliation. We can provide a 7-day retention export. If they require HSM for keys that's a Private deployment conversation.

Priya Patel: Example shim curl to hand their infra:

```bash
curl -X POST https://shim.mercurypay.poc/api/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <MERC_POC_KEY>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"prompt":"Summarize charge 901","max_tokens":56,"stop":["\n\n"],"temperature":0.0}'
```

Priya Patel: Shim will: map params, run vendor tokenizer to report token_count, echo X-Request-Id, and allow deterministic mode (seeded) to reduce variance during billing checks.

Tom Alvarez: Acceptance criteria proposal: median latency <= 120ms, p95 <= 250ms on staging; token_delta_rate <= 1% on canonical set; no persisted raw customer API keys. Deliverables: diff CSV (prompt, vendor_text, redwood_text, token_delta), latency report, and secQ answers.

Ben Goldman: Security: upload the secQ (they attached a 6-page doc). We can provide SOC2 summary + pen-test date in the response. I'll start drafting answers; flagging KMS/HSM and key handling for follow-up.

Ellen Park: Pricing: recommend fixed POC fee + usage + small adapter surcharge (cpu overhead). Tom/Tess from sales ops to provide numbers. Timeline: sandboxes ready in 48h kickoff in 72h.

security-bot: Sandbox 'mercurypay-poc-09' provisioned (sbx-129). Credentials uploaded to vault; access granted to thread participants.

Priya Patel: I'll push a minimal harness repo and a token-report script by EOD. Tom, Ben, I'll DM for allowlist IPs and secQ details.

Ellen Park: Thanks team. We'll confirm customer tolerance on exact token parity and sync tomorrow @9am PT.
